subject: Virtual onsite choreography: asymmetric panel sequencing + debrief handoffs
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alex Romero <alex.romero@gmail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Virtual onsite: two-track sequence proposal

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for your time last week. We want to propose a compact virtual onsite on Tuesday, Aug 10 that minimizes total time on camera while still getting full cross-functional coverage. Here’s a proposed choreography (attached PDF):

- Slot A (30m): Hiring manager + product behavioral (Lauren)
- Slot B (30m, runs parallel with Slot A): Infra/runtime deep dive (Marissa)
- Short break (15m) 
- Slot C (45m): System-design + architecture walk-through (combined panel: Vivek + Lauren)
- Slot D (30m): Culture & cross-team collaboration, candidate questions (Marissa + hiring panel)
- 15m buffer + 30m debrief immediate synchronous sync (optional for interviewers)

Why asymmetric? We reduce candidate fatigue by parallelizing two narrow deep-dives (A and B) and then converging for the design discussion. To make evaluations consistent, we’ll assign debrief ownership so each interviewer focuses on one rubric area and submits a short anchor note immediately after their slot.

Attachments: virtual-onsite-agenda (PDF); I also requested your resume from Ops and attached it — please let me know if the copy is out of date. Calendar invite (ICS) will follow once we confirm time.

Can you confirm whether 9:30am–12:00pm PDT on Aug 10 works for you? If not, propose two alternatives within that day.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Recruiting Partner
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Romero <alex.romero@gmail.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Virtual onsite: two-track sequence proposal

Hi Rishi —

9:30am–12:00pm PDT on Aug 10 works great for me. I appreciate the shorter parallel slots — that’ll be much easier than a single long day. A couple quick questions:

- How long are the breaks between the parallel block and the system-design? (I want a short buffer to grab water)
- Will you share the design prompt ahead of time or is it live?

I attached an updated resume (most recent role added). Thanks for coordinating — excited to meet the team.

Best,
Alex Romero
Resume: candidate-resume-Alex-Romero.pdf

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Virtual onsite: two-track sequence proposal

Thanks Rishi — solid plan. A few logistics from hiring mgmt side:

- Break: keep it to 15 minutes between the parallel block and design (candidate asked; confirmed). We’ll add a 10–15m jitter buffer on both parallel invites so we don’t cascade if the first group runs long.
- Prompt: Vivek, can you confirm whether you want the system-design prompt shared 24h in advance or presented live? My preference is short pre-read (1 page) so the candidate can prepare at a high level; we still want to evaluate live synthesis.
- Debrief ownership: I’ll own product/strategy signals; Marissa will own infra/runtime performance & latency tradeoffs; Vivek will capture architecture depth and long-term platform fit. Please keep notes in the shared rubric doc (link below) and add a 1–2 sentence anchor after your interview.

Rubric link: https://redwood-drive.company/Docs/Interview-Rubrics/VM-Panel-Rubric

I’ll roster another panel backup (senior PM) in case a slot collision happens. Can someone add the calendar invites and include Zoom + recording turned off by default?

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop | Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alex Romero <alex.romero@gmail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>, ops-recruiting@hirehub.io
Date: 2027-08-01T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Aug 10 virtual onsite + invites + next steps

Alex —

Confirmed for Tue, Aug 10, 2027 · 9:30 AM–12:00 PM PDT. Calendar invites and the updated agenda are attached; invite includes two parallel Zoom links (Slot A and Slot B) and one converged link for the design slot. I included 10m jitter buffers on the parallel slots as Lauren asked.

Quick checklist for interviewers (please read / act):
- Review panel rubric and add 1–2 sentence anchor immediately after your slot: https://redwood-drive.company/Docs/Interview-Rubrics/VM-Panel-Rubric
- Marissa: you own infra/runtime notes and will collect latency/throughput follow-ups if any
- Lauren: you own product/strategy notes and hiring calibration
- Vivek: you own architecture & long-term platform fit; please drop a mock prompt in the doc by EOD Friday if you want a pre-read

Candidate notes (from Alex): candidate prefers short pre-read for design, wants 15m break. We accommodated both. Alex attached an updated resume — thanks Ops for pushing that file into the thread.

Attachments: 20270801-virtual-onsite-agenda.pdf, 20270801-virtual-onsite-invite.ics

If any hard conflicts surface, flag to me and we’ll swap the backup PM into the panel slot. Thanks everyone — see you Aug 10.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra | Recruiting Partner
Redwood Inference
